shortDescription: Configures a SQL Agent job schedule

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the schedule is enabled or disabled.

options.name: end_date
options.description: The date on which execution of a job can stop. If I(force=true) the end date will be C(99991231), via dbatools. Format is C(yyyyMMdd).

options.name: end_time
options.description: The time on any day to end execution of a job. Format C(HHMMSS) (24 hour clock). If (force=true) the start time will be C(23:59:59).

options.name: force
options.description: The force option will ignore some errors in the options and assume defaults. It will also remove the any present schedules with the same name for the specific job.

options.name: frequency_interval
options.description: The days that a job is executed. Allowed values for I(frequency_type=Daily) - C(EveryDay) or a number between C(1) and C(365) inclusive. Allowed values for I(frequency_type=Weekly) - C(Sunday), C(Monday), C(Tuesday), C(Wednesday), C(Thursday), C(Friday), C(Saturday), C(Weekdays), C(Weekend) or C(EveryDay). Allowed values for I(frequency_type=Monthly) - Numbers C(1) through C(31) for each day of the month. If C(Weekdays), C(Weekend) or C(EveryDay) is used it overwrites any other value that has be

options.name: frequency_recurrence_factor
options.description: The number of weeks or months between the scheduled execution of a job. Required if I(frequency_type=Weekly), I(frequency_type=Monthly) or I(frequency_type=MonthlyRelative).

options.name: frequency_relative_interval
options.description: A job's occurrence of I(frequency_interval) in each month. If I(frequency_interval=32) (C(MonthlyRelative)).

options.name: frequency_subday_interval
options.description: The number of subday type periods to occur between each execution of a job.

options.name: frequency_subday_type
options.description: Specifies the units for the subday I(frequency_interval).

options.name: frequency_type
options.description: A value indicating when a job is to be executed. If I(force=true) the default will be C(Once).

options.name: job
options.description: The name of the job that has the schedule. Schedules and jobs can also be associated via M(lowlydba.sqlserver.agent_job). See U(https://docs.dbatools.io/New-DbaAgentSchedule) for more detailed usage.

options.name: sql_instance
options.description: The SQL Server instance to modify.

options.name: start_date
options.description: The date on which execution of a job can begin. If I(force=true) the start date will be the current day. Format is C(yyyyMMdd).

options.name: start_time
options.description: The time on any day to begin execution of a job. Format C(HHMMSS) (24 hour clock). If I(force=true) the start time will be C(00:00:00).

options.name: state
options.description: Whether or not the object should be C(present) or C(absent).
